_readme: The ONE source of hours. Status strip, quick facts, footer, /visit, /tonight and JSON-LD all read this file. Times are 24h 'HH:MM' in New York time. A close time earlier than the open time (e.g. 16:00 to 01:00) means after midnight. An empty list [] means closed that day.
source: Current thefycnyc.com (Oct 2026). Google, OpenTable and Birdeye list different hours; confirm one master set (report Q9).

brunch._readme: Weekend daytime kitchen service. Confirm (report Q10).

exceptions._readme: Holiday closures or special hours, keyed by date YYYY-MM-DD. Example: "2026-11-26": { "note": "Thanksgiving Family Supper", "bar": [{ "open": "16:00", "close": "22:00" }], "kitchen": [] }
